messages:
elena: Quick plan to repro the KV-warmup batching spike and capture with nsys.

elena: Running on-staging with a small client that hits the batching path. Command I used:
```
nsys profile --trace=cuda,nvtx,osrt --output=run_kv_warmup -f --sample=cpu --sample-frequency=1000 --duration=20 --capture-range=nvtx -- python3 tools/run_client.py --workload batch_kv
```
elena: Notes: --trace=cuda,nvtx,osrt to get kernel timeline + nvtx brackets + osrt sampling. --capture-range=nvtx to focus on the request window (we wrap start/end with nvtx markers in code).

sam: Nice. fyi if you run on a short duration you'll miss the kernel selection flip — make duration >= 10s after steady-state warmup :point_up:

tyler: Also try --sample-frequency=2000 to reduce overhead but still get hotspots.

katie: When you do capture-range=nvtx remember to disable auto-batching jitter in the client or you'll see different batch sizes between traces.

elena: Good catch. I forced batch_size=8 and disabled jitter. Also included NVTX markers in the runtime around kv cache lookup and kernel dispatch:
```
nvtxRangePushA("req_start");
...dispatch path...
nvtxRangePop();
```

elena: Initial observation: around 5.4s into the trace there's a burst of small kernels on sm_80_fp16_fallback and then a long stall while the dispatch switches to a different kernel (int8_quant) — looks like kernel selection logic chose a slower path under certain seq_len distribution.

sam: Can you upload the sqlite output? use -o run_kv_warmup so we can open in Nsight GUI.

elena: Uploaded run_kv_warmup.nsys-rep (link in thread). The timeline shows OSRT sampling points clustered during the stall; NVTX brackets line up with stalled kvcache eviction.

tyler: Suggest capturing a second run with --capture-range=nvtx:op to include the whole process spawn if you suspect startup differences.

katie: If you want lower overhead traces for perf regression CI, use --sample=none + trace=cuda,nvtx and a shorter --duration but you'll miss CPU-side scheduling hotspots.

elena: Plan: (1) repro run with longer duration (60s) and sample-frequency=2000, (2) second run with capture-range full process to compare, (3) bisect kernel selection change in runtime and add additional NVTX around kernel selector. I'll post updates.

nsys-bot: capture saved as run_kv_warmup.nsys-rep, sqlite export run_kv_warmup.sqlite

sam: Thanks — this will help isolate whether it's a kernel selection bug or an input distribution change. :100:
